name: Mall Straight Floor Module 2 m
summary: A 2 m square precast floor module with sixteen flush ivory terrazzo pavers, warm grey joints and three levels of detail.
description: A 2 m square precast floor module with sixteen flush ivory terrazzo pavers, warm grey joints and three levels of detail.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original parametric Blender geometry with rounded paver corners, a flush filled-joint mesh and a layered precast backing. The distant atlas samples the owner-project terrazzo artwork.
accuracy_notes: Generic visual model for the modular mall. Dimensions and measured joins describe the digital geometry. Physical device performance and construction suitability have not been evaluated.

attribution.credit: Original model for Blender-3D-Gallery. The finish and baked atlas reuse the original project-owned terrazzo seed 421 texture from mall-floor-tile.

rights: Original owner-project geometry and texture. Reuse in the owner’s projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms are unspecified.
